fonts.display: 'GT America Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
fonts.body: 'Nimbus Sans Extended', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Warm Charcoal
palette.role: Primary action background (filled CTA buttons), high-prominence borders, dark surface bands, nav and footer text on light backgrounds

palette.name: Soft Black
palette.role: Body text, headings on light backgrounds, general borders, link text — the workhorse dark neutral

palette.name: Pure White
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, text on dark hero/footer bands, outlined action borders (ghost buttons on dark imagery)

palette.name: Ash Gray
palette.role: Secondary surface for alternating sections, subtle background bands

palette.name: Signal Blue
palette.role: Blue accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.
